item.title: My three notebooks
item.description: The first is an A5 notebook, sometimes in a vibrant red color other times in black, always hardcover. It usually stays at work, and is only taken out of the office for work-related purposes. I use it to keep notes of work-related material and to record the minutes from the meetings I attend. Everything I write at work is written in this notebook. I need roughly one notebook every three months.
